video_title: NIKOLA JOKIĆ BEZ FILTERA | Ekskluzivni razgovor sa Miletom Ilićem

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on his involvement in the design of his 361° signature shoes
quotes.excerpt: I was involved in the design. The first logo was on the first shoe. We agreed to change it.

text_blocks.speaker: Mile Ilić
text_blocks.text: The new shoes are here. They look good, and you told me they are comfortable.

text_blocks.speaker: Nikola Jokić
text_blocks.text: Yes, they are. They are very comfortable. I was involved in the design. The first logo was on the first shoe. We agreed to change it. On the third one, we agreed that on every new shoe, there should be something new, something different compared to the other shoes. I was involved in the design, and I really like how it looks.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Mile Ilić: Nove patike su tu. Lepo izgledaju, a sad si mi rekao da su i udobne.
Nikola Jokić: Jesi, jesi. Ovaj je, pa ovaj, kao povoljne su. Da napravimo neki prodajni materijal. Šalim se. Pa u samom početku su one su dobile ovaj one su zadužene da kažem za dizajn i za sve to njihova je stvarna ideja. Stvarno za ovaj za za ovaj za za ove sam čak malo ja učestvovao u ovome. Prvi logo je bio kao na na ovaj na ovde na na na na prvim patikama je bio logo ovde i sad na drugim smo se kao dogovarali da pravimo negde drugo. I sad na trećim smo se kao dogovarali da treba na svakom na na svakom novim patikama da bude nešto od novo, da bude drugačije u odnosu na ostale patike, da bude nešto drugačije. I meni se ovo svidelo.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on why he chose to partner with 361°
quotes.excerpt: Aaron Gordon, who has been playing with me for a few years, was a connection.

text_blocks.speaker: Mile Ilić
text_blocks.text: When 361° reached out, what made you decide to sign with them?

text_blocks.speaker: Nikola Jokić
text_blocks.text: Aaron Gordon, who has been playing with me for a few years, was a connection. He was the first person I saw wearing them. He told me about them, and I started looking into it. I even have his first shoes, the Aaron Gordon 1. They had a really good shape, and I liked it. When I got the contract offer, I was looking for what I could get, and Aaron Gordon told me what he could. A connection was made, and they were really professional. The communication and the relationship were great. They respected me in a way, and I am really grateful for the cooperation.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Mile Ilić: Reci mi ovako, kad se javio 361, šta je prelomilo da doneseš odluku da budeš sa njima?
Nikola Jokić: Pa to je ovaj, Aaron Gordon, što igra sa mnom već od koliko godina. On je da kažem neki i neki neka spojnica i neki kod njega sam prvi put video i on mi je rekao za njih i sve to. I onda sam počeo da gledam. Čak imam i njegove prve patike, te neke Aaron Gordon 1. Bile su tako nekako skroz dobre oblik patike i meni se to svidelo i onda je kad je meni stigao ugovor sa prethodnim ovaj sa prethodnim patikama, ja sam ovaj neću da kažem tražio, ali tražio sam šta može i onda mi to Gordon rekao i onda je stupila neka konekcija i oni su stvarno bili na jednom na jednom na jednom na super profesionalnom nivou, komunikacija, odnos. Stvarno su da kažem nekako ispoštovali me na neki način i stvarno sam zahvalan najpre za saradnju.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokić
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokić on his 'Joker's done, let's go home' quote after winning the title
quotes.excerpt: I often stay alone in the locker room because I have my own routine.

text_blocks.speaker: Mile Ilić
text_blocks.text: What was going through your head when you were left alone in the locker room with the trophy?

text_blocks.speaker: Nikola Jokić
text_blocks.text: I often stay alone in the locker room because I have my own routine. I do some work in the training room, some stretching, and I have a cold tub. So I really need time, and when we are on the road, everyone is waiting for me. But I often say that it is one of the most beautiful feelings when you stay alone in the locker room when all the noise is gone and when everyone is gone, and you stay somehow alone for two, three, five, 10, 15, 20 minutes. Some feelings and some emotions somehow gather and it becomes a really beautiful moment. But I also had that feeling then. The job is done, somehow the relief is greater than the euphoria. I felt more relief than euphoria. I won, I said, 'Ugh, we won.' I felt like I took a burden off my back.

quotes.verbatim_original_language:
Mile Ilić: Zanima me posle, ovaj, kad si ostao sam u svlačionici sa trofejom, šta ti je prošlo kroz glavu?
Nikola Jokić: Ovaj, pa vidi, ovaj, to je, ja često ostanem sam u svlačionici pošto ovaj, zadnji sam i na ovaj, imam neki svoj ritual, ali nešto uradim u teretanu i, ovaj, neko istezanje i imam neku hladnu kadu, tako da mi stvarno treba vremena, ovaj, i kad smo na gostovanju i svi me čekaju. Ali ovaj, ja često kažem da je to jedan od najlepših osećaja kad ostaneš sam u svlačionici kad cela buka ode i kad svi se raziđu i onda ostaneš nekako sam, dva, tri, pet, 10, 15, 20 minuta, ovaj, nekako stvarno se svi neki osećaji i sve neke emocije nekako se skupe i nekako bude baš, baš, ovaj, lep neki momenat. Ali isto sam imao i tada osećaj, posao je završen, nekako možda sam ja lično ovaj osećao neko više olakšanje nego uzbuđenje nego euforiju. Ja sam osećao neko olakšanje više nego što sam osetio neku euforiju. Kao, osvojili smo, više sam rekao, uh, osvojili smo. Nekako sam pre, osetio neki skinuo teret sa leđa.
